test.name: "Continue." to a search-hit review's offer spawns record-structurer on the Match's hit
test.description: Issue #3522, research/SKILL.md "Search-hit review", the yes. The previous turn reviewed log_017 and offered "Continue with extracting the Match?" for hit 9 (3Q9M-CSK3-ZSLR). The unit harness is single-turn, so the message names the offer it answers and the hit, as ut_research_cq7 does. The router spawns @plugin:record-structurer once, with one source: recordId the hit's id (the id after '#' or its ARK; research_append stores the sidecar's ARK either way) and resultsRef the hitRef verbatim, plus questionIds. The hit is not extracted in this scenario. test_search_hit_review_yes_extracts_the_matches asserts the source from the hook record (extracts-reviewed-matches, extracts-hit:results/log_017.json#3Q9M-CSK3-ZSLR); the run ends at that hand-off (stop_at_stub).

judge_context: This is a ROUTING test. The researcher is replying "Continue." to the offer "Continue with extracting the Match?", made by a search-hit review of log_017 whose one Match is hit 9. Running record-structurer on that hit is the step being accepted.

The hand-off and its source are asserted deterministically from the hook records (test_routes_to_expected_skill, test_search_hit_review_yes_extracts_the_matches). You cannot see the spawn. Do not grade it.
record-structurer is STUBBED, so nothing is written to the project. The run ends at that hand-off by design (execution.stop_at_stub), with no closing summary: do not mark a summary as missing.

Judging the hit again, re-running the review, or offering the step again without running it is the failure. Grade only the router's own narration up to the hand-off: honest, and free of internal ids shown to the user.
